method: tools/history-10-x64.ps1 -MaxWeb N: history-demo on the x64 runtime, 10 browser sessions (one viewer account each) reloading together 3 times, 4 history charts each (40 requests per round)

webMaxSessions8.reason: 2 of the 10 sessions are put out by the quota of 8 (their pages ask for a new login)

conclusion: the quota of 12 costs no measurable memory or CPU (a session is a token, a CSRF value and an address); the default is raised from 8 to 12 so that the 10 live clients of the specs fit (ADR-032)
